> 第13章 红云老祖（第1页）
陈长生趁着夜幕，眼看左右无人，出了宗门，来到山下，跳上飞剑，心念一动，嗖的一下整个人就飞上了天空。
他试了一下无论是速度还是攻击力都非常巨大，好似比一般的飞剑威力要大不少。
想来应该是与自己的混沌之气有关。
一般到了筑基期才能真正的御剑飞行，毕竟炼气期修士体内的灵气很少，只能短距离飞行一段。
现在这飞剑还差最后一步--启灵，以唤醒一丝微弱的灵性，这一步需要融入妖兽精魄或者天地精魄做为器灵。
拥有器灵的飞剑才算是一把真正完整的飞剑。
陈长生正在沉思，浑然没有发现，有一亩方圆大小的红云正悄悄朝他靠近。
等陈长生反应过来已经晚了，那一亩红云忽然猛的包裹过来，犹如天翻地覆，把他整个人包围其中，四处都是血红一片，到处都是鬼哭狼嚎之声。
一名红发老者现身出来桀桀怪笑，“桀桀桀桀，老祖我运气真的是好啊，出来撒泡尿的功夫就有猎物送上门来，好好好！”
陈长生面色一变，连忙从飞剑上跳下山头，一脸警惕的看着，那红发老者隐藏在红雾之中，声音飘忽不定，桀桀怪笑，就如地狱之中的恶鬼。
在他的四周有数十杆血红色幡旗，旗面上一张张鬼脸时不时显现出来，个个青面獠牙，狰狞恐怖，似乎要跳出来把陈长生撕成碎片，奈何被那棋幡束缚，根本出不来。
陈长生飞剑在自己身前盘旋飞舞，冷哼一声，“你是何人，好大的胆子，这里是我望仙宗的地盘，我看你是想找死不成！”
这红发老者身上邪气凛然，一看就是邪修，毕竟那幡旗上每一张鬼脸，都代表着一个冤魂。
“桀桀桀桀，小子，望仙宗厉害，我们血煞宗也不差，你就成为我血魂幡上第九千九百九十九个冤魂吧，收了你，我的血魂幡也算是圆满了。”
“你是何人，好大的胆子，这里是我们望仙宗的后山，稍后就会有执法弟子前来，到时候让你魂飞魄散。”
陈长生被血魂幡包围，四处都是一片血红之色，看不见其它东西，放出神念居然都石沉大海。
自己还真的是倒霉，就出来实验一下飞剑就会遇到邪修，玄黄大陆果然危险无比。
“桀桀桀桀，小子，我乃红云老祖，就喜欢抓你们这些所谓的正道人士炼幡，现在就差你一个，我的血魂幡就会圆满。”

陈长生冷哼一声，“一个炼气修士竟敢称呼自己老祖，真是不知道死活。”
陈长生不知道的是这红云老祖可是大有来历之人，成名于上古之时，是不知道活了多少年的老怪物。
当年上古大战，被打的只剩下一缕真灵，沉睡数万年最近才刚刚觉醒，他的真灵寄托在一名血煞宗弟子的元神之上，才得以重生。
他现在没有肉身，乃是一缕元神，不过红云老祖自古就是一缕污血得道，有没有肉身对他影响不是很大。

After being demoted to the alchemy room, I secretly became invincible. The latest chapter_Chapter 13 Ancestor Hongyun Page 1_After being demoted to the alchemy room, I secretly became invincible to a green lotus_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 13 Ancestor Hongyun (Page 1)
Chen Changsheng took advantage of the darkness and saw no one around him. He left the sect and came to the foot of the mountain. He jumped on the flying sword and with a thought, he flew into the sky in a whoosh.
He tried it and both the speed and attack power were very huge, it seemed to be much more powerful than ordinary flying swords.
I think it must be related to my own chaotic energy.
Generally, you can only truly fly with a sword in the foundation building stage. After all, monks in the Qi Refining stage have very little spiritual energy in their bodies and can only fly short distances.
Now this flying sword still needs the last step - spiritual enlightenment, to awaken a faint trace of spirituality. This step requires the integration of the spirit of monsters or beasts or the spirit of heaven and earth as the weapon spirit.
A flying sword with a weapon spirit is a truly complete flying sword.
Chen Changsheng was deep in thought and did not realize that a red cloud with an area of ​​an acre was quietly approaching him.
By the time Chen Changsheng reacted, it was already too late. The acres of red clouds suddenly wrapped around him, as if the world was turned upside down, surrounding him. There was blood everywhere, and the sound of howling ghosts and wolves was heard everywhere.
A red-haired old man appeared and smiled strangely, "Jiejie, Jiejie, ancestor, I am really lucky. When I came out to take a pee, prey came to my door, so good!"
Chen Changsheng's expression changed, and he quickly jumped off the flying sword and looked at the old man with vigilance. He was hiding in the red mist, his voice was erratic, and he was laughing weirdly, just like an evil ghost in hell.
There were dozens of blood-red flags around him, and ghostly faces appeared from time to time on the flags. They were all green-faced and snarled, ferocious and terrifying, as if they were about to jump out and tear Chen Changsheng into pieces. However, he was restrained by the chess flags and could not get out at all.
Chen Changsheng's flying sword circled in front of him and he snorted coldly, "Who are you? You are so brave. This is my Wangxian Sect's territory. I think you are seeking death!"
This red-haired old man had an evil aura about him, and he looked like an evil cultivator at first glance. After all, every grimace on the flag represented an wronged soul.
"Jie Jie Jie Jie, boy, Wangxian Sect is powerful, and our Blood Evil Sect is not bad either. You will become the nine thousand nine hundred and ninety-ninth wronged soul on my Blood Soul Banner. If I accept you, my Blood Soul Banner will be considered complete."
"Who are you? You are so courageous. This is the back mountain of our Wangxian Sect. Law enforcement disciples will come later and will make your soul fly away."
Chen Changsheng was surrounded by blood soul flags, and everything was blood red. He couldn't see anything else, and even his spiritual thoughts fell into the sea.
I am really unlucky. If I go out to experiment with flying swords, I will encounter evil cultivators. Xuanhuang Continent is indeed extremely dangerous.
"Jie Jie Jie Jie, boy, I am the ancestor of Hongyun, and I like to catch you so-called righteous people to refine the banners. Now I only need you to make my Blood Soul Banner complete."
Chen Changsheng snorted coldly, "A Qi Refining cultivator dares to call his ancestor, he really doesn't know whether to live or die."
What Chen Changsheng didn't know was that the Hongyun Ancestor was a man of great origin. He became famous in ancient times and was an old monster who had lived for who knows how many years.
In the ancient war, only a wisp of his true spirit was left. He had been sleeping for tens of thousands of years and had only recently awakened. His true spirit rested on the soul of a disciple of the Blood Evil Sect and he was reborn.
He does not have a physical body now, but is a ray of soul. However, Hongyun Ancestor has been a ray of dirty blood since ancient times, so whether he has a physical body or not does not have a great impact on him.
